admission.justification: A later recovery change must not drop a sidecar or broaden auto-carry evidence. Pair-level comparisons and public document-kind assertions guard this unit; memory_only_evidence shows the unchanged-base prerequisite statically (no separate new runtime claim for every branch).

applicability: The selected converted carryover document unit and evidence-tier selection.
conditions: A file card, route overview, memory-only document and entity catalog travel as Markdown plus their JSON sidecar.
A memory-only document auto-carries only with nonempty all-current anchors and an unchanged target pair since a resolved memory merge base.
Existing code tiers exact-landed-commit, patch-id-match and final-content-match keep their meaning.
exclusions: Official anchor observation/re-recording is the separate PartB §8 guarantee; record dependency closure is PartB §9; write/restore mechanics are PartB §10.
Anchorless documents, changed target-since-base or no merge base require review; there is no assumed currentness.
Record Markdown companions are governed by the existing optional record schema, not the mandatory document pair.

evidence: Frozen generation3 source inspection; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: A carried file card, overview, memory-only document or entity catalog is its Markdown plus JSON sidecar, with unchanged code evidence tiers.
